outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart of HMGB1 signal intensity (mean ± SD) with error bars but no overlaid individual data points, despite n>100 cells and N=4 mice being averaged.
The lower graph is a bar chart of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (mean ± SD, N=4 mice, n>400 cells) shown only with error bars, without individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod vs. weeks) with error bars; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel E consists of line plots (time on rotarod across days at different weeks) with error bars; line plots are exempt from this check.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot, which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel G shows only histological micrographs (Calbindin/DAPI staining), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H contains two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, mean ± SD, N=3, n=9) showing only error bars without individual data points overlaid.
